messages.subject: Setting number of significant figures in facet boundaries...
parts:
This is not the best example code for this question, but I'm curious if there is
a way to set the number of significant figures that are displayed in the facet
labels. I would like to be able to increase or decrease the number of
significant figures, so any insight and feedback is very much appreciated.


Thanks again for the insights...


library(diptest)
library(ggplot2)

VADeaths_flat_df = stack(as.data.frame(VADeaths))
names(VADeaths_flat_df) = c('Data','Person')
counts <- ddply(VADeaths_flat_df, .(cut(Data, breaks=fullseq(range(Data), 20)),
Person), nrow)
names(counts) <- c("bin", "person", "n")
qplot(person, n, data = counts, fill = person, geom="bar", stat="identity",
width = 0.9) + facet_grid(. ~ bin) + opts(axis.text.x = NULL) +
opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(colour = "red")) + opts(strip.text.x =
theme_text(colour = "green", size=14))

#grid.gedit("text", gp = gpar(fontsize=14, col="red"))
# Formatting seems to work better for the PDF plot.
Test_title<-paste("TestCode.pdf", sep = "")
ggsave(file=Test_title)

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Setting number of significant figures in facet boundaries...
parts:
Hi Jason,

The key is the cut:

VADeaths_flat_df$Data <- VADeaths_flat_df$Data * 1e3
breaks <- fullseq(range(VADeaths_flat_df$Data), 20 * 1e3)

cut(VADeaths_flat_df$Data, breaks = breaks)

n <- length(breaks)
pretty <- prettyNum(breaks, big.mark = ",", preserve.width = "none")
labels <- paste("(", pretty[-n], ",", pretty[-1], "]", sep = "")
cut(VADeaths_flat_df$Data, breaks = breaks, labels = labels)

labels <- paste(pretty[-n], "-", pretty[-1], sep = "")
cut(VADeaths_flat_df$Data, breaks = breaks, labels = labels)

Hadley
